caption:
# GUI Interface Description

## Top Bar
- **Left Side**:
  - "Activities" button
  - "Files" application icon with a dropdown menu
- **Center**:
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 17:36"
  - Notification bell icon
- **Right Side**:
  - System status icons including:
    - Network connectivity
    - Sound/volume control
    - Power button

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - Files application icon
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Terminal icon
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon for application overview

## Main Window Content

### Terminal Window
- **Title Bar**:
  - Text: "user@user-virtual-machine: ~"
  - Minimize, maximize, and close buttons
- **Content**:
  - Command prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine:~$"
  - Cursor at end of prompt
  - Background color: Dark purple

### File Manager Window
- **Title Bar**:
  - Text: "Home"
  - Minimize, maximize, and close buttons
- **Navigation Bar**:
  - Back and forward navigation buttons
  - Home icon
  - Search bar
  - More options button (three dots)
  - Search icon
  - View options button (three horizontal lines)
  - View mode dropdown (three horizontal lines with downward arrow)
- **Left Sidebar**:
  - "Recent" section with clock icon
  - "Starred" section with star icon
  - "Home" section with house icon (currently selected)
  - "Desktop" with folder icon
  - "Documents" with document icon
  - "Downloads" with download icon
  - "Music" with music note icon
  - "Pictures" with image icon
  - "Videos" with video camera icon
  - "Trash" with trash can icon
  - "Other Locations" with plus sign
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Grid of files and folders
  - Visible items:
    - Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures, Public, requirement.txt
    - server, snap, Templates, Videos
    - .bash_history, .bash_logout, .bashrc
    - .cache, .config, .gnupg, .ipython, .lessht, .local, .mozilla, .var
    - .pki, .profile, .selected_editor, .ssh, .sudo_as_admin_successful, thunderbird
    - .viminfo, .vscode

## Context Menu
- **Location**: Appears above the "Files" application icon in the top bar
- **Content**:
  - "New Window" option
  - "Quit" option

## Desktop Background
- **Visual Style**: Geometric, polygonal pattern
- **Color Palette**: Gradient from dark purple to red-orange
- **Desktop Icon**:
  - "Home" folder icon located at bottom right corner
  - Label: "Home" below the icon
